critical_code_review_comments: tracking_module.create_share_token has no auth dependency declared on the FastAPI route — but it lives under router(prefix='/tracking') which does NOT inherit verify_token. Currently any unauthenticated caller could mint a share token if they guess a route_id+os_number. Recommend adding Depends(verify_token) to /share-token, /gps, /live/{route_id}, /breadcrumb endpoints. The review_request DOES describe /share-token and /gps as 'autenticado', but the implementation does not enforce it. Tests still pass because Authorization header is ignored when not required; this is a real privacy/security gap.
tracking_module.upsert_gps and get_live_position also lack auth enforcement — same risk; any external party with a route_id can poison the live position or scrape it.

Privacy filter exposes 'address' (street name) on public endpoint; that is intentional per spec, but it still discloses the customer street. Acceptable tradeoff since the customer is the recipient of the link, but worth documenting.

_temp_pdf_store is process-local in-memory dict — does NOT scale beyond a single backend pod and is lost on restart. Spec explicitly allows the 24h TTL+memory tradeoff, but a Mongo-backed alternative (with TTL index) would be more robust.

JWT_SECRET default 'default_secret' in tracking_module.py differs from server.py default 'change-me' and from backend/.env 'mastermaq_secret_key_2024_secure'. If env var ever disappears, the two modules will sign with different keys and tokens become inconsistent. Recommend a single source of truth.
server.py is now 2302 lines — continues to deserve modularization (see iteration_3 comment); temp-pdf endpoints could go into a dedicated files_module.py.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Tests pick an existing route+os_number to mint a share-token and call POST /tracking/gps with São Paulo coords (-23.5505,-46.6333) to verify live propagation. The tracking_live document is upserted by route_id (no orphaned docs). The store_and_fetch test inserts a 'TEST_iter26.pdf' entry into the in-memory store with 24h TTL; it auto-expires.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 26 backend complete — all 17 tests pass. Re-run: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration26_rbac_tracking.py -v. Tests auto-load REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env when env var missing.
